# C reference performance

Release build of the reference configuration in `build/c-release`, measured 2026-10-20T13:43:12Z to 2026-10-20T13:54:14Z on a 8-CPU aarch64 kvm machine (kernel 7.1.8-200.fc44.aarch64). Figures are medians; compare only builds measured on this machine, by the same script.

```
curl 8.23.1-DEV (Linux) libcurl/8.23.1-DEV OpenSSL/3.5.9 zlib/1.3.1.zlib-ng brotli/1.2.0 zstd/1.5.7 c-ares/1.34.8 libidn2/2.3.8 libpsl/0.21.5 libssh2/1.11.1 nghttp2/1.68.0 ngtcp2/1.25.0 nghttp3/1.18.0 mit-krb5/1.22.2 OpenLDAP/2.6.15
```
